description:
A sleek, panther-like six-legged predator with three pairs of clawed legs, a feline tail, and two barbed tentacles rising from its shoulders. Its current original-game template records no carried items or wealth. The new combat art depicts a planted ready stance followed by an in-place roar with the two front legs rearing and the rear shoulder tentacle striking forward.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT - READY:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ready frame for OpenGold combat sprite MON7CHA.DAX:68/default; later exported to 128x128 transparent PNG.
Primary request: Draw one original Displacer Beast as a muscular black panther with purple highlights, facing RIGHT in a low, long stalking guard. It has precisely THREE PAIRS OF LEGS: two hind legs under the rump, two middle legs under the belly, and two front legs under the shoulders. Count the image: exactly SIX distinct legs and SIX separate paws touching a single ground line. The foremost pair is behind the head; NO leg grows from the neck or under the head. Its long feline body connects all six limbs. Add ONE normal feline tail and exactly TWO long barbed-pad tentacles growing upward from the shoulders. Broad feline head, pointed ears, alert golden eyes, muzzle and whiskers, closed snarling mouth.
Composition: wide side / slight front-three-quarter view. Leave clear transparent space to the right of the nose so the action frame can thrust its head forward and open the jaws. All paws planted. Low body with no squashing; keep tentacles compact enough for a 2-wide by 1-high combat-square silhouette. No drawn grid. Entire creature and every tentacle tip visible with transparent outer margin.
Style: crisp classic fantasy game pixel art, large readable shapes rather than fine painting, high contrast silhouette at tiny 128x128 use. Real transparent background.
Constraints: ONE image, ONE creature, exactly six legs/six paws/two shoulder tentacles/one tail. No seventh paw, neck limb, extra tentacle, armor, weapon, rider, scenery, spell effect, ground shadow, text, border or sprite sheet. Invent the design independently; do not copy official D&D or original game art.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT - ACTION:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: exactly ONE corrected ACTION frame for OpenGold combat sprite MON7CHA.DAX:68/default, exported as a transparent 128x128 PNG.
Input Image 1 is the currently accepted NEW ready sprite and the exact edit target. Use its black-violet fur palette, purple edge highlights, golden eyes, six-leg anatomy, two barbed shoulder tentacles, feline tail, body proportions, camera, scale, and canvas placement. No original game art is attached.
Keep the long body, belly, pelvis, tail base and the four middle/hind legs registered at their exact ready-frame coordinates. Lift BOTH FRONT LEGS off the ground and rear them up in a forceful threatening attack; clearly show exactly six legs total, two raised front paws and four grounded middle/hind paws. Do not grow legs from the neck or duplicate a paw. Keep the chest continuously attached to the abdomen and hips, with only a modest forward/upward shoulder lean. Open the feline mouth WIDE in a ROAR toward screen right, exposing upper and lower fangs and dark mouth interior; keep the head attached to the neck. The REAR shoulder tentacle, the one that begins farther left in ready, reaches clearly FORWARD toward screen right with its barbed pad pointed toward the target. Keep the second shoulder tentacle distinct and recognizable. Preserve the exact ready black-violet-purple colors; do not make action brighter, pinker or redder. The changes should be visually obvious at 128x128 combat size.
This creature occupies two squares wide and one square high. Keep every body part and tentacle within the 128x128 transparent PNG margin. Do not recenter, shrink, crop or slide the whole animal. Exactly one full-body six-legged Displacer Beast and one ACTION frame, no duplicate, diptych, sheet, extra tentacle, weapon, armor, magic effect, scenery, shadow, text, opaque background or black box.
